description: This file defines a static class 'MasterFlows' that provides a set of asynchronous methods for creating, updating, and querying various master reference data entities such as UOMs, reporting programs, control devices, equations, and status codes within the system. It acts as a façade for calling repository methods with logging and request handling.

classes.name: MasterFlows
classes.description: A static class providing asynchronous methods to manage master/reference data entities like UOMs, reporting programs, control devices, equations, and status codes.

methods.name: CreateUomAsync
methods.description: Creates a UOM master record, logs the operation, and returns the created UOM DTO.

methods.name: UpdateUomAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing UOM master record identified by UOM ID, returns the updated DTO or null if not found.

methods.name: QueryUomsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of UOM master records based on the provided query parameters.

methods.name: CreateReportingProgramAsync
methods.description: Creates a reporting program master record, logs the operation, and returns the created DTO.

methods.name: UpdateReportingProgramAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing reporting program record by ID, returns the updated DTO or null.

methods.name: QueryReportingProgramsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reporting program master records based on the query.

methods.name: CreateControlDeviceAsync
methods.description: Creates a control device master record, logs the operation, and returns the created DTO.

methods.name: UpdateControlDeviceAsync
methods.description: Updates a control device master record by ID, returns the updated DTO or null.

methods.name: QueryControlDevicesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves control device master records filtered by site ID and query parameters.

methods.name: CreateEquationAsync
methods.description: Creates an equation master record, logs the operation, and returns the created DTO.

methods.name: UpdateEquationAsync
methods.description: Updates an equation master record by ID, returns the updated DTO or null.

methods.name: QueryEquationsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of equation master records based on the query.

methods.name: CreateStatusCodeAsync
methods.description: Creates a status code master record, logs the operation, and returns the created DTO.

methods.name: UpdateStatusCodeAsync
methods.description: Updates a status code master record by ID, returns the updated DTO or null.

methods.name: QueryStatusCodesAsync
methods.description: Queries status code master records based on query parameters.
